nora (product): Quick sync: we need a compact plan for the long-term routing + multi-region + tenant isolation work. Main goals: per-route region pins, measurable latency tiers, and a compliance-ready isolation artifact. Target pilot in ~3 months. Thoughts?

eli (eng-platform): Agree. We should define 3 lanes: latency-sensitive, standard, economical. Each lane gets an SLO band (p95/p99) and allowed fallback semantics. Also need a small infra-cost model.

paul (arch): Propose a minimal policy manifest v0: fields = selector, allowed_regions, tier, fallback_policy, lock. Make precedence deterministic: exact selector > prefix > global. Emit audit events for every routing decision.

anya (infra): Operational caveat: cross-region fallback implies cold KV caches and egress. We must estimate warmup penalty per prefix and include that in routing decisions. I'll run 3 sims (spike/steady/burst) once we have sample QPS.

rachel (solutions): Customer asks summary: enterprise wants route-level region pin + signed audit log; mid-market wants a cheaper lane even if p99 is worse; regulated customers want migration checklists. We'll map to launch criteria.

nora (product): Draft pilot gates: (1) two pilot customers using pinned routes or dedicated lanes; (2) defined SLOs by lane with measured numbers; (3) migration runbook + rollback; (4) exportable routing audit + signed attestations for private deployments; (5) policy UI (basic).

eli (eng-platform): Risks: live rule rollout causing flapping; incompatible manifest versions; fallback storms. Add safety: dry-run, per-tenant fallback opt-out, and emergency routing-freeze.

paul (arch): Example manifest sketch: ```route "org:acme/chat" { regions:["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]; tier:"latency"; fallback:{region:"us-east-1",model:"small-quant"}; lock:false }``` Enforcement should return (decision, reason, cache_hit).

anya (infra): I'll estimate GPU impact, egress, and cold-cache ms for three traffic archetypes. ETA: 10 days.

rachel (solutions): I'll collect three customer requirement docs and map them to the gates (1 week).

tom (sales): I have one pilot willing to join if we can show p95 and failover delta. I'll try to add a second.

infra-bot: scheduled: infra/experiment/policy-proto deploy by paul at 2024-10-10T11:00:00Z

nora (product): Action items recap: paul+eli draft policy + enforcement sketch (EOW); anya sims (10d); rachel customer mapping (1w); tom pilot recruitment (ASAP); I'll produce milestone roadmap + gating checklist by Friday. Flag any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
